questions.q: What sound does a cow make?
questions.fact: A cow chews its food, swallows it, and then chews it again later!

questions.q: Which animal has a long trunk?
questions.fact: An elephant's trunk can pick up something as small as a peanut.

questions.q: Which animal says "quack"?
questions.fact: A duck's feathers are oily, so water rolls right off.

questions.q: Which animal lives in the ocean?
questions.fact: Whales are mammals, so they come up to the surface to breathe air.

questions.q: Which animal has black and white stripes?
questions.fact: Every zebra has its own stripe pattern, a bit like a fingerprint.

questions.q: What do we call a baby dog?
questions.fact: A puppy is born with its eyes shut and opens them after about two weeks.

questions.q: Which animal hops and says "ribbit"?
questions.fact: A frog can also breathe a little through its skin.

questions.q: Which animal is the tallest?
questions.fact: A giraffe has a very long neck, but only seven neck bones, just like you!

questions.q: Which animal gives us milk on a farm?
questions.fact: A farm cow can give several big buckets of milk in one day.

questions.q: What do we call a baby cat?
questions.fact: Kittens sleep a lot, up to sixteen hours a day.

questions.q: Which animal makes honey?
questions.fact: A honey bee visits lots of flowers to make just a little honey.

questions.q: Which animal has a shell on its back?
questions.fact: A turtle's shell is part of its body, so it can never take it off.

questions.q: Which bird cannot fly but is a great swimmer?
questions.fact: Penguins use their wings like flippers to zoom through the water.

questions.q: Which animal has a big loud roar?
questions.fact: A lion's roar can be heard from about five miles away.

questions.q: What do we call an animal that eats only plants?
questions.fact: Cows, rabbits and deer are herbivores.

questions.q: Which of these animals is a mammal?
questions.fact: Dolphins breathe air and feed their babies milk.

questions.q: How many legs does an insect have?
questions.fact: Spiders have eight legs, so they are not insects.

questions.q: What is a group of lions called?
questions.fact: A pride can have many lions and their cubs living together.

questions.q: Which animal can change its color to blend in?
questions.fact: A chameleon also changes color to show how it is feeling.

questions.q: What does a caterpillar turn into?
questions.fact: Inside its chrysalis or cocoon, a caterpillar's body changes completely.

questions.q: Which animal sleeps hanging upside down?
questions.fact: A bat is the only mammal that can truly fly.

questions.q: What do we call a baby kangaroo?
questions.fact: A joey lives in its mother's pouch while it grows.

questions.q: Which animal is the fastest runner on land?
questions.fact: A cheetah can sprint faster than cars drive on many town roads.

questions.q: Which of these animals is a reptile?
questions.fact: Reptiles have dry, scaly skin.

questions.q: What does a fish use to breathe underwater?
questions.fact: Gills take oxygen out of the water as it flows past.

questions.q: Which bird is famous for hooting at night?
questions.fact: An owl can turn its head far around to look behind it.

questions.q: What is the biggest animal in the ocean?
questions.fact: The blue whale is the biggest animal we know of that has ever lived.

questions.q: Which is the largest animal living on land?
questions.fact: An African elephant can weigh as much as several small cars.

questions.q: What word describes animals that are mostly active at night?
questions.fact: Owls, bats and many mice are nocturnal.

questions.q: Which bird flies from the Arctic to the Antarctic and back each year?
questions.fact: The Arctic tern makes one of the longest migrations of any animal.

questions.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.fact: Two of its hearts serve the gills and one serves the rest of its body.

questions.q: What do we call animals that have a backbone?
questions.fact: Fish, birds, reptiles, amphibians and mammals are all vertebrates.

questions.q: Which group of animals do sharks belong to?
questions.fact: A shark's skeleton is made of cartilage, the same bendy stuff as your ears.

questions.q: What do we call a scientist who studies insects?
questions.fact: Entomologists study more than a million known kinds of insects.

questions.q: Which animal's fingerprints look a lot like human fingerprints?
questions.fact: Koala fingerprints are so like ours that they are hard to tell apart under a microscope.

questions.q: Which mammal lays eggs?
questions.fact: The platypus and the echidnas are the only mammals that lay eggs.

questions.q: What is a group of owls sometimes called?
questions.fact: Old stories say a group of owls is wise enough to hold a parliament.

questions.q: Which sense is a dog's strongest?
questions.fact: A dog's nose has hundreds of millions of scent sensors, far more than a person's.

questions.q: Which bird is the fastest diver in the sky?
questions.fact: A peregrine falcon can dive faster than 180 miles per hour.

questions.q: What do we call a big group of fish swimming together?
questions.fact: Swimming in a school helps small fish stay safe.

questions.q: What is the name of the dance a honey bee does to show where flowers are?
questions.fact: The direction and length of the waggle tell other bees where to fly.

questions.q: Which animal can drop its tail and grow a new one?
questions.fact: Many lizards can let go of their tail to escape, and it grows back.
